summary: The PR correctly implements the required field-level visibility allowlist and secret masking functions as specified in Ticket T30. All unit tests pass, and the implementation adheres to the constraints regarding legacy signatures and behavior.
key_findings: project_allowed_fields correctly filters record keys based on role_fields and always includes 'id' if present.
mask_secret correctly masks leading characters with '*' and handles short strings by masking the entire value.
Legacy function has_role remains unchanged and its test passes.
All 3 unit tests pass with exit code 0.
